title: Fallout 3 Janus Bear Exact Context Ledger Schema
purpose: Provide non-heuristic exact cell/location labels for comparing tragedy scenes, child rooms, stores and ordinary clutter after ESM export.
admission_rules: location_key must come verbatim from the reference export
each label must cite manual scene evidence or a directly descriptive cell/location role
do not infer CHILD_ROOM solely from presence of a teddy
do not infer TRAGEDY solely from teddy/skeleton proximity being tested
ambiguous locations remain OTHER or unlabeled
category labels must be frozen before reading enrichment outcome when used for confirmatory statistics
